scope: Public TextEditor.edit Undo-stop options and empty builders through native command dispatch/history; entire stable API and personal migration remain required.

source_cohort.selection: git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard; unique existing files, sorted UTF-8 relative paths
source_cohort.digest_algorithm: sha256(concatenate(path UTF-8 + NUL + raw sha256(file bytes)))

items: Public options retain defaults/coercion and one-read capture; stale getters and empty builders dispatch no partial work
All four Undo-stop pairs join or separate actual native typing with shared CRLF save/Undo/Redo
Inactive views and invalid captures retain display, selections, identity and native Redo
Complete native/host regressions, unchanged Sort Lines controls, ten terminal scenarios and required style checks retain source evidence

qualification_conditions: Final full native regression passes on the recorded source: four new native document cases and one actual selected-host/App integration are included. The latter exercises all four stop pairs.
Three new host cases cover option capture, reentrant source refusal and empty builders. The final complete host run includes the readonly no-op case.
Eleven actual terminal scenarios cover undo stops (2), existing EOL (1), Position replacements (1), snippets (4), decorations (2) and virtual documents (1).

Ten adjacent terminal scenarios and the four unchanged Sort Lines controls ran before the test-only read-only fixture correction. Production Rust/host implementation and their fixtures did not change afterward. The final native/host regression and the affected native/terminal virtual workflows run after that correction.

The existing snippet history grouping is reused. Native ordinary navigation/palette boundaries, owner/model/view/version/resource/save proofs and callback capacity are retained. Empty API builders do not authorize a native mutation.
These are named local Linux workflows, not qualification of all global Undo/history or the whole stable API. Personal code remains unactivated.

failed_observations_retained.observed: The first real App case with false/false retains P after Undo instead of reverting preceding typing: generic command dispatch had closed its history before the extension callback.
failed_observations_retained.repair: Known registered/dormant extension commands leave Undo boundaries to their edit options; native command boundaries remain. All four App pairs and contributed F9 now pass.

failed_observations_retained.observed: Initial full native run has 1689 passes, one failure and 23 ignored: the prior virtual-document fixture expects an empty edit to return false.
failed_observations_retained.repair: Pinned upstream _applyEdit returns true before native dispatch for an empty builder. Correct only that assertion, retaining mutating-edit=false, save=false, exact content/version, native model/history and original disk checks. Final full native regression passes.
